title: Boone County Planning Commission — Special Business Meeting form source availability gap
evidenceScope: The preserved Boone County Planning Commission Applications and Forms page lists Special Business Meeting (BM, PH, & BOA) and links Forms/SpecialBM.pdf. On 2026-10-02, two bounded fetch attempts to that exact official URL returned HTTP 403 with text/html rather than a PDF, including a retry using browser-style headers and the official page as referrer. Therefore no PDF archive, byte count, PDF hash, form contents, filing requirements, fees, approval standards, or sign-project applicability are claimed. This record preserves a source-availability gap only; the HTML denial responses are not archived as the form.
